title: Entropy-Based Local Characteristic Decomposition
summary: Local characteristic decomposition (LCD) is widely used in high-order numerical methods for hyperbolic systems of conservation laws to reduce spurious oscillations appearing in the computed solutions. The LCD implementation requires a representative average interface state, typically obtained using arithmetic or Roe-type averages of the nearly grid values. We propose an entropy-based LCD (ELCD), in which the states in the two cells adjacent to an interface are considered together with several nearby states in phase space.
